notes: Each sample mounts a fresh list, runs the untimed setup, forces GC through CDP, then times one synchronous operation including its DOM commit; layout and paint are excluded.
Modes alternate within each round and the starting mode rotates per round and process; ratios divide each Ranvier sample by the Solid sample of the same round.

Rows follow js-framework-benchmark keyed: id text, label signal in an anchor, a remove anchor with a span, an empty cell; two click handlers per row. Solid's For keys by row identity, Ranvier's t.each by row id.
Retained heap is GC-stabilized JavaScript heap per row of a mounted list, excluding DOM node memory outside the V8 heap.
pairRatios divide each numerator sample by the denominator sample of the same process and round; ci95 is a percentile bootstrap of their median.
CPU load before the run (after the build; Win32_Processor LoadPercentage, three readings 2 s apart): 96, 85, 91 %
CPU load after the run (Win32_Processor LoadPercentage, three readings 2 s apart): 87, 90, 100 %

Run on the shared machine (plan 2026-10-24-issue-157.md, Decision P7): other lanes ran builds and tests throughout; each ranvier-arms-match sample is paired with the ranvier-sugar sample of the same process and round, and the verdict is the paired median and its 95 % interval against 1.05. All four intervals straddle 1.05.
